caseName: Levitt v. Committee for Public Education & Religious Liberty
caseNameFull: Levitt, Comptroller of New York v. Committee for Public Education & Religious Liberty and La Salle Academy v. Committee for Public Education & Religious Liberty

opinions.text:
Appeals from D. C. S. D. N. Y. Judgment vacated and cases remanded for further consideration in light of Wolman v. Walter, ante, p. 229.

Mr. Justice Brennan, Mr. Justice Marshall, and Mr. Justice Stevens would affirm the judgment.

Reported below: 414 F. Supp. 1174.
